notes: ⚠️ REQUIRES JAVASCRIPT RENDERING (Playwright/Selenium). This is a Vue.js application that loads data via AJAX. Static HTML only contains Vue templates ({{ rental.title }}, etc). The page uses MLS Property Information Network data. Pagination is handled via JavaScript (@click.prevent). Real-time scraping would require: 1) Headless browser (Playwright/Selenium), 2) Wait for Vue app to load, 3) Wait for AJAX data to populate. Alternative: Investigate if there's an API endpoint at /client/idx.php that returns JSON when called with proper headers.
